verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no documentation of SendGrid API rate limits, requests-per-second figures, burst behavior, rate-limit headers, or throttling errors (e.g. 429). It has only generic 'send email at scale' marketing and community anecdotes about monthly volume, which are not documented throughput limits.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can find the documented throughput and rate limits — requests per second, burst behavior, and the headers or errors that signal throttling
